Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite animation asset, NOT separate character illustrations.
Reproduce the provided Yuuki child exactly, same crisp shaded pixel artwork, age 9, modest black-and-white dress, white hair, red eyes, white socks, black shoes and same head-to-body proportions. No weapons, no halo. Real transparent background, no shadow cloud, no text, no effects.
ANIMATION COHERENCE IS THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: the upper 80 percent of the character must look almost copied between cells. Exactly fixed head, face, eyes, hair volume, black bow, wings, torso, dress shape, proportions, scale and camera. Only legs below the dress and small arm swings change. No leaning suddenly, no bouncing head, no flaring skirt, no flying hair or wing flaps, no zoom. Keep all poses on the same registration and baseline. Show both feet clearly.
Four compact progressive poses, no extreme kick, no very wide splits, no tucked-up jumping pose. The maximum travel of a shoe from one cell to the next should be about one shoe length. Every frame leads naturally to the next INCLUDING frame 4 to frame 1. The body remains nearly still, feet carry the animation. No foot teleports, no repeated lead leg in both contacts, no blur, no distorted anatomy, no fused feet.
Each character fully inside its cell with transparent margin for all hair and feathers. Match the reference pixel detail, do not add details. Never change the two wing colors between poses.
Use a FOUR column by TWO row sheet, exactly eight full characters. Every character faces screen LEFT, at the exact reference angle. Near wing is BLACK (anatomical LEFT wing), far wing is WHITE (anatomical RIGHT). Forward is screen left; backwards is screen right.
Row 1 WALK, left to right: 1 short contact with NEAR foot slightly forward and FAR foot slightly back; 2 both feet near center with far foot passing, only slightly raised; 3 short opposite contact, NEAR foot slightly back and FAR foot forward; 4 both feet near center with NEAR foot passing, only slightly raised. Four-cell repeating cycle. Use a gentle small stride, shoes separated by at most 1.5 shoe lengths in contact poses.
Row 2 RUN, left to right: same near/far alternation and four phases, with a slightly larger stride and slightly more bent knees than walking, not a huge leap. 1 near contact, 2 far leg passes with feet close below hips, 3 far contact with near foot back, 4 near leg passes with feet close below hips. Keep shoe separation at most 2 shoe lengths, no foot above the dress hem. The faster playback will communicate running, not an exaggerated crouch or body jump. Upper body of running must stay same height as walking; a tiny steady forward posture is allowed but identical throughout this row.

targetedCorrections.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact transparent eight-cell Yuuki sprite sheet; maintain EXACTLY four columns and two rows. Keep the exact Yuuki appearance, exact fixed upper body in every cell, all heads, eyes, hair, WHITE near wing and BLACK far wing, dress, scale, pixel shading and positions unchanged. Correct ONLY the legs in column 3 and column 4, in both rows. All other artwork is locked. No halo or weapons, actual transparent background.
The character faces RIGHT. The camera-facing NEAR leg is the leg with the pale white sock; far leg has a little grey shadow.
COLUMN 3 must be OPPOSITE CONTACT to column 1: NEAR pale sock and shoe step BACK toward screen LEFT, FAR grey-shadowed sock and shoe step FORWARD toward screen RIGHT. Show both shoes separated by a small stride; the near shoe must now clearly be at LEFT and the far shoe at RIGHT. Near knee goes slightly back, far knee goes forward. Do not repeat column 1.
COLUMN 4 must be OPPOSITE PASSING to column 2: NEAR pale-socked knee comes forward toward RIGHT, its shoe is slightly LIFTED just ahead of the far shin. FAR grey-socked foot is PLANTED directly below the hips. This means the FRONT/right pale shoe is lifted and the left/central shadowed shoe supports the character. Both feet close together, only a small lift. Do not lift the rear leg in column 4.
Row 1 gentle walk, row 2 compact jog. In running the lift is only slightly greater, no jump, no shoe above skirt. This forms a four-phase gait: near contact, far passing, far contact, near passing. Preserve everything outside those legs exactly. Transparent margins, no outlines from background or glow.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact front-facing Yuuki four-frame running sheet, 2 by 2 layout. Keep the exact fixed head, torso, dress, wings, scale, identity, face and pixel details unchanged in ALL cells. WHITE wing remains viewer LEFT, BLACK wing viewer RIGHT. No halo or weapons, actual transparent background.
Correct ONLY the legs in the two BOTTOM cells. Top row unchanged.
BOTTOM LEFT (frame 3): opposite short contact to top-left. The VIEWER LEFT foot is forward and lower, visibly PLANTED. VIEWER RIGHT foot is back and slightly higher. Thus the bigger front shoe must now be on viewer LEFT, not the right. No wide split, keep shoes near the hips.
BOTTOM RIGHT (frame 4): passing between frame 3 and top-left. VIEWER LEFT foot comes back toward the center and remains planted; VIEWER RIGHT foot passes next to it and is only slightly raised. Both shoes must nearly be at the same height, with just a small foot lift. Do not make this another extreme contact pose. Maximum shoe movement between adjacent drawings about one shoe length.
All four drawings must show TWO separate legs. No high knees, no crouch, no flying hair, no changes to the head, no enlarged shoes or sudden body bounce. This is a gentle repeating four-pose jogging animation, not four unrelated action illustrations. Preserve the existing artwork except the specified lower legs.
